description: This PHP file defines a function 'displayEmailAddressOptInField' that renders an opt-in status indicator for an email address associated with an Email object. It includes logic to handle email validation, logging warnings and errors, and fetching email address data for display.

methods.name: displayEmailAddressOptInField
methods.description: Generates and returns an HTML snippet indicating the opt-in status of an email address related to an Email object, with validation and logging.
